scope: 16 logical pages in English, Chinese, French, Japanese, German and Russian; 96 complete source pages including 24 releases across 9.x–13.x.

baseline.source_snapshot_checksums: all SHA256SUMS entries passed; pinned upstream sources and existing archives were not modified

parallel_groups: French and German: every page read, compared and reread
Japanese and Russian: every page read, compared and reread
Chinese and English source: every page read, source implementation/README/POD/ChangeLog checked and revised pages reread
review_method.root_finalization: Shared, implementation-verified errata and technical search metadata were synchronized across all six languages. Final fingerprints bind the current reviewed edition.
review_method.language_number_notation: 16 exact source/target body-hash exceptions were reviewed for word-vs-digit notation; version/date/decimal changes cannot use these exceptions.

fixes: Complete translated main and SSH help, argument explanations, exit codes and example comments in all five translations; complete Chinese 9.x–13.x release records.

French: corrected N byte ranges versus N bytes per range, seekable input, non-core Perl dependencies, frequent errors/events, backward compatibility, excluded database reports, missing rds/bind details, buffer hit/miss and incorrectly added frequency semantics.
Japanese: corrected question-mark anonymization, deprecated versus removed behavior, prepare/bind terminology, POD preservation and historical time-filter details; standardized technical terminology.
Chinese: corrected reserved-pool terminology and translated pseudocode/directory explanations; Russian wording and historic conditions were reread and corrected.

Corrected upstream errata in all six editions: 2919-05 year, misplaced confidential-data continuation, escaped jsonlog delimiters, idle-time grouping, missing code delimiter, --exlucde-time and misspelled PostgreSQL settings.

Added implemented --ssh-sudo omitted from upstream help; documented noninteractive sudo requirement, xz --robot and lz4 --content-size prerequisites, current CSV comma default, and whole-hour scope of the pg_dump filter example.
Distinguished historical release behavior from current operational settings.
Added search_keywords, query-token aliases and command-reference search boost so log settings and hyphenated CLI options are discoverable in every locale.
Generator now writes only six English reference pages, preserves all translations, reproduces reviewed errata and supports a read-only --check.

Added exact explanatory-fence and bare literal protection, source/translation numeric reviews, final semantic fingerprints, 13 regression tests, rendered/search/Markdown/LLMS checks and desktop/mobile browser QA. Generated evidence is restricted to paths outside the repository.

changes: Removed translation/editorial policy introductions, license snapshot sections and fidelity claims in all six locales; no new reader-facing policy disclosure.
Kept translated explanatory text; updated all five language guides with exact, reviewed pgBadger text-fence exception while preserving code and literal protection.
Replaced release-index source-history commentary with functional version navigation; retained actual release entries and implementation-verified corrections.
Standardized the 11.5 idle-time formula to the exact ASCII source expression in every locale and added protected snippet checks.
editorial_revisions.semantic_verification: Complete scoped editorial reread by locale groups; fences, executable examples, contributor names, legal original and release/version facts independently checked.
editorial_revisions.final_cleanup: Simplified all six sample-report introductions to offline availability and removed the Chinese fixed-implementation wording; legal notices and technical prerequisites reread and preserved.

site_gate_repairs.patroni: Restored 12 links in all six release pages to their exact upstream Read the Docs destinations.
site_gate_repairs.shared_heading_parser: Fixed link-definition/list-item thematic breaks wrongly parsed as Setext headings, retaining legitimate Setext headings and anchor enforcement.
site_gate_repairs.shared_numeric_parser: Recognizes complete U+202F three-digit integer grouping without waiving version, decimal, identifier or code literal checks.
site_gate_repairs.attribution: Synchronized the German and Russian HAProxy source details, dates and version literals and removed obsolete partial-language claims.
site_gate_repairs.pgbouncer: Aligned quotes around three unchanged German historical diagnostic strings and reread that paragraph before refreshing its exact review.
site_gate_repairs.quoted_diagnostic_protection: Only the three complete original quoted diagnostics on the German PgBouncer changelog are excluded from prose lint; altered, appended, removed and duplicated messages are rejected by the component gate.

upstream_update_check.local_update: skipped because released version and documentation are unchanged
